findings.title: GTM container GTM-5FWVZL4K is referenced but not published
findings.detail: The site requests GTM-5FWVZL4K, but googletagmanager.com returns 404, so the container is unpublished or deleted. Any tags expected from it never fire.
findings.recommendation: Remove the snippet (theme or Shopify custom pixel), or publish the container if it's meant to be live.

findings.title: Ad pixels fire on load (no banner shown to this visitor)
findings.detail: Enzuzo is present but showed no banner to this US visitor; AppLovin, Campaign Manager 360 / Floodlight, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, Microsoft Ads (UET), Pinterest Tag, TikTok Pixel fired on load — consistent with a US opt-out model.
findings.recommendation: Confirm EU/UK visitors get an opt-in banner and US opt-out (Do Not Sell / GPC) suppresses these pixels.

findings.title: Needs attention: Microsoft Ads — First-party ID cookie set
findings.detail: Cookies after the visit: none of _uetsid, _uetvid. Why it matters: First-party IDs keep attribution and audiences working as third-party cookies disappear.
findings.recommendation: Check the tag/app is allowed to set first-party cookies (consent, ITP, cookie flags).

findings.title: Needs attention: Stack — Third-party request volume
findings.detail: 1624 third-party requests across the visit (25 identified platforms). Why it matters: Tag weight slows pages, which costs conversion rate.
findings.recommendation: Audit apps/pixels that don't earn their weight.

analyst_checklist.item: Do GA4 revenue and Google Ads / Meta purchase counts reconcile with Shopify orders (a gap above ~10% usually means a tracking problem)?
Is the Facebook & Instagram app's data sharing set to 'Maximum' (Conversions API on), and what Event Match Quality do Purchase events get?
Which conversion action is primary for purchases — the Google & YouTube app, a GTM tag or a GA4 import — and is enhanced conversions on?
Do you sell into the EU/UK or Quebec, and how is consent handled for those visitors?
A GTM container loads but has no live tags — was it meant to take over from the apps, or can it be removed?
